en.headline: Flag-draped coffin leaves North Point after Tung state funeral
en.dek: The public memorial began at 9am at Hong Kong Funeral Home; John Lee was among the pallbearers as the hearse departed at 10.13am.
body: A state funeral for Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, was held on Sunday morning at Fuk Hoi Tong of the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, after a vigil on Saturday. The invitation-only public memorial and encoffining began at 9am.

RTHK reported that Shi Taifeng, a Politburo member who chairs the funeral committee, arrived with deputy chairs Wang Dongfeng, Leung Chun-ying and Xia Baolong. Chief Executive John Lee and Liaison Office director Zhou Ji greeted them outside the hall. Other officials present included Financial Secretary Paul Chan, Secretary for Justice Paul Lam and Secretary for Security Chris Tang.

A national flag covered the coffin as it was carried from the hall. Dimsum Daily and other outlets said Lee was among the pallbearers and that a hearse left the funeral home at 10.13am, closing the ceremony. Floral wreaths filled the forecourt and the playground across Java Road, with a large police presence nearby.
Condolence books at three Home Affairs Department centres — Causeway Bay, Kai Tak and Tsuen Wan — remained open until noon for members of the public who were not invited to the hall.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬完成 國旗覆蓋靈柴離開北角
zh.dek: 公祭大殓今早九時在北角香港殮儀館福海堂舉行，李家超等扶靈，靈車約十時十三分離開。
body: 香港首任行政長官董建華的國葬週日上午在北角香港殮儀館福海堂舉行，公祭大殓於九時開始，僅獲邀人士出席。周六已先設靈。
港台報道，治喪委員會主任委員、中共中央政治局委員石泰峰，聯同副主任委員王東峰、梁振英及夏寶龍抵達，行政長官李家超及中聯辦主任周霿在門外迎接。財政司司長陳茂波、律政司司長林定國及保安局局長鄧炳強等官員亦有到場。
靈柴覆蓋國旗後由扶靈隊伍送出禮堂。多家傳媒報道李家超有分扶靈，靈車約十時十三分離開殮儀館。館外及對面渣華道遊樂場擺滿花牌，警方在附近維持秩序。
未獲邀入場的市民，仍可在銅鑼灣、啟德及荃灣三個民政事務總署凴喻處簽署凴喻冊，週日開放至中午十二時。
